answer: Sybils can be resisted with an onyx-anchored crystal lattice. First, each agent binds its identity to one onyx key: one device, one identity, no clones. Second, reputation grows like a crystal, each verified task adding a layer; a fresh account holds zero. Third, only agents with thirty layers earned over thirty days may attest others. Fourth, peers can shatter a lattice caught faking, burning its bond. Forging ten thousand fakes needs 10,000 keys at $120 each, $1.2 million, plus 300,000 days of work. Like a juniper that takes years to root, reputation grows slowly and cannot be rushed.
